skill.name: Choir Bells
skill.simpleDescription: Taunt, slow, and apply vulnerability to nearby mobs.
descriptions:
Trigger: Press key.swapOffhand while Sneaking        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Slow all nearby mobs.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: 10% Slowness for 8s        
        ▶ Radius: 10 Blocks        
                 
        Heretics are also taunted, take damage, and        
        are inflicted with weakness and vulnerability.        
                 
        ▶ Damage: 8 (⭐)        
        ▶ Effect: 20% Weakness for 8s        
        ▶ Effect: 25% Vulnerability for 8s        
        ▶ Cooldown: 16s        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Choir Bells now tolls 2 more times, every 3s.        
                 
        The extra tolls deal less damage, taunt mobs,        
        and inflict weaker debuffs for a shorter time.        
                 
        ▶ Damage: 3 (⭐) (to Heretics)        
        ▶ Effect: 10% Slowness for 3s        
        ▶ Effect: 15% Vulnerability for 3s (to Heretics)        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
skill.extraDescription:
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        ʀᴇɢɪᴏɴ ѕᴄᴀʟᴇᴅ        
        Damage values will change depending        
        on the region you're currently in.        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

skill.name: Dagger Throw
skill.simpleDescription: Throw daggers that deal damage and apply vulnerability.
descriptions:
Trigger: key.attack while Sneaking        
        Requirement: Holding Two Swords        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Throw a fan of 3 daggers in front of you,        
        dealing damage and inflicting vulnerability.        
                 
        ▶ Damage: 4 (🗡)        
        ▶ Effect: 20% Vulnerability for 10s        
        ▶ Range: 8 Blocks (Cone-Shaped)        
        ▶ Cooldown: 10s        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Increase Dagger Throw's damage        
        and vulnerability.        
                 
        ▶ Damage: 4 → 8 (🗡)        
        ▶ Effect: 20% → 40% Vulnerability        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Dagger Throw's daggers stay stationary        
        at the end of their path for 5s.        
                 
        Recast Dagger Throw to return the daggers        
        to you and deal reduced damage.        
        (Automatically returns after 5s)        
                 
        ▶ Return Damage: 80% (🗡) of original        
                 
        Dagger Throw now silences mobs it hits.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: Silence for 2s        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

skill.name: Haunting Shades
skill.simpleDescription: Place a Shade that debuffs nearby enemies with Vulnerability.
descriptions:
Trigger: Press key.swapOffhand        
        Requirement: Holding a Scythe        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Summon a Shade that inflicts nearby        
        mobs with vulnerability.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: 10% Vulnerability        
        ▶ Radius: 6 Blocks        
        ▶ Duration: 7s        
        ▶ Cooldown: 10s        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Players near the Shade deal increased        
        damage and are healed while nearby.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: +10% Damage        
        ▶ Healing: 2.5% HP every 1s        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

skill.name: Judgement Chain
skill.simpleDescription: Teleport a mob to you and debuff it.
descriptions:
Trigger: Press key.swapOffhand        
        Requirement: Holding a Scythe        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Chain a target mob to you and teleport        
        them in front of you, taunting them and        
        afflicting them with slowness and weakness.        
        (Knockback/crowd control immune mobs won't        
        be teleported)        
                 
        Deal increased damage to Chained mobs.        
                 
        ▶ Damage Boost: +25% to Chained mobs        
        ▶ Effect: 40% Slowness for 3s        
        ▶ Effect: 40% Weakness for 3s        
        ▶ Charges: 2        
        ▶ Cooldown: 12s (per charge)        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Increase Judgement Chain's damage boost.        
                 
        ▶ Damage Boost: +25% → +50% to Chained mobs        
                 
        Judgement Chain now Chains and teleports 2        
        additional mobs closest to the target.        
                 
        ▶ Radius: 3 Blocks        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

skill.name: Melancholic Lament
skill.simpleDescription: Weaken nearby mobs and force them to target you.
descriptions:
Trigger: Press key.swapOffhand while Sneaking        
        Requirement: Holding a Scythe        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Weaken and taunt all nearby mobs.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: 20% Weakness for 8s        
        ▶ Radius: 8 Blocks        
        ▶ Cooldown: 16s        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Increase Melancholic Lament's weakness,        
        and lower the duration of your potion        
        debuffs on cast.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: 20% → 30% Weakness        
        ▶ Effect: -10s Debuff Duration        
                 
        After casting Melancholic Lament, your        
        next attack within 4s will silence the        
        target and all nearby mobs.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: Silence for 3s        
        ▶ Silence Radius: 3 Blocks        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        After casting Melancholic Lament, you and        
        nearby players will deal increased melee        
        damage for each mob targeting you.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: +2.5% Melee Damage per mob (max 6)        
        ▶ Duration: 8s        
        ▶ Radius: 16 Blocks        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

skill.name: Meteor Slam
skill.simpleDescription: Swing your weapon to damage mobs and vault yourself upward. Passively generate a slam attack when fallen from great heights.
descriptions:
Trigger: Press key.swapOffhand while Sneaking        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Vault upwards and gain jump boost.        
                 
        Passively, falling more than 3 blocks creates        
        a slam upon landing, dealing more damage for        
        each block fallen. Fall damage is cancelled        
        if any mob was hit by the slam.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: Jump Boost 4 for 2s        
        ▶ Slam Damage: 3 (🗡) per block (7 block softcap)        
        ▶ Slam Radius: 3 Blocks        
        ▶ Cooldown: 8s        
                 
        Sneaking midair spends 1 stack of Bloodlust        
        to turn the slam into a ground pound with        
        more damage, more radius, and causing it        
        to ignite mobs and knock them back.        
        (Can cast once per vault)        
                 
        ▶ Damage Boost: +50%        
        ▶ Radius Boost: +50%         
        ▶ Effect: Fire for 5s        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Increase Meteor Slam's damage, jump        
        boost level and reduce its cooldown.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: Jump Boost 4 → Jump Boost 5        
        ▶ Slam Damage: 3 → 4 (🗡) per block        
        ▶ Cooldown: 8s → 6s        
                 
        Meteor Slam's ground pound now inflicts        
        vulnerability and slowness.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: 15% Vulnerability for 3s        
        ▶ Effect: 15% Slowness for 3s        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

skill.name: Scorched Earth
skill.simpleDescription: Deploy a circular zone in which your potions break into fragments that Scorch enemies.
descriptions:
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Throwing a potion while sneaking creates        
        a scorched area that lasts for 10s.        
                 
        The area slows and weakens mobs inside, and        
        mobs entering it are Scorched for +2s.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: 25% Slowness        
        ▶ Effect: 10% Weakness        
                 
        Potions that splash inside the area break into 3        
        smaller fragments that Scorch mobs for +1s.        
                 
        Scorched mobs take rapid damage over time.        
        Its duration can be stacked up to a maximum of 5s,        
        which is consumed over time.        
                 
        ▶ Scorch Damage: 40% (⭐) over 1s (of potion damage)        
        ▶ Radius: 6 Blocks        
        ▶ Charges: 2        
        ▶ Cooldown: 30s (all charges refreshed at once)        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Increase Scorched Earth's slowness,        
        weakness, and the damage of Scorch.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: 25% → 35% Slowness        
        ▶ Effect: 10% → 15% Weakness        
        ▶ Scorch Damage: 40% → 50% (⭐)        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

skill.name: Smokescreen
skill.simpleDescription: Blind, weaken, and slow mobs in an area.
descriptions:
Trigger: Press key.swapOffhand while Sneaking        
        Requirement: Holding Two Swords        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Launch a smoke bomb that afflicts        
        mobs with slowness and weakness.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: 20% Slowness for 4s        
        ▶ Effect: 20% Weakness for 4s        
        ▶ Radius: 6 Blocks        
                 
        Mobs within the impact zone are also        
        blinded.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: Blindness for 1s        
        ▶ Cooldown: 20s        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Increase Smokescreen's weakness,        
        increase its radius, and reduce its        
        cooldown.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: 20% → 30% Weakness        
        ▶ Radius: 6 → 8 Blocks        
        ▶ Cooldown: 20s → 16s        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Smokescreen deals damage upon impact        
        and leaves a lingering cloud that        
        continuously applies its effects.        
        (Does not include Blindness)        
                 
        ▶ Damage: 12 (🗡)        
        ▶ Cloud Duration: 8s        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
skill.extraDescription:
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        ʙʟɪɴᴅ        
        Blinded mobs cannot attack, but        
        can still cast spells.        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

skill.name: Spiritcatcher Orbs
skill.simpleDescription: Your totems burst into Spiritcatcher Orbs which bind to and debuff attacked mobs.
descriptions:
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        When a Totem expires or is destroyed, it leaves        
        behind 3 orbs that can be picked up by players.        
        Breaking a spawner picks up all orbs.        
                 
        You can hold up to 12 orbs at once, and they        
        begin to decay after 8s of not gaining any.        
                 
        Your attacks and projectiles consume 1 orb        
        to deal more damage and afflict the target        
        with Spiritflame.        
                 
        ▶ Damage Boost: +20% (🗡/🏹)        
                 
        Spiritflame deals damage over time to the mob and        
        nearby mobs with the same name. If the mob dies, the        
        Spiritflame continues to burn where it died.        
                 
        ▶ Damage: 5 (⭐) every 1s        
        ▶ Radius: 12 Blocks        
        ▶ Duration: 4s        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Increase the damage and duration of Spiritflame.        
                 
        ▶ Damage: 5 → 6 (⭐) every 1s        
        ▶ Duration: 4s → 6s        
                 
        Spiritflame now weakens the afflicted mob and        
        makes them take increased magic damage.        
        (Weakens all damage types, instead of        
        only melee or projectile damage)        
                 
        ▶ Effect: 20% Weakness        
        ▶ Effect: 10% Magic Vulnerability        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

skill.name: Steel Trap
skill.simpleDescription: Throw a trap to stagger mobs.
descriptions:
Trigger: Press key.drop        
        Requirement: Holding a Projectile Weapon        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Throw a Trap that primes after 1.5s and lasts for 10s.        
        (Underwater nets prime instantly)        
                 
        When a mob gets within 2 blocks of the Trap,        
        it damages and staggers nearby mobs.        
                 
        ▶ Damage: 5 (🏹)        
        ▶ Effect: Stagger for 2s        
        ▶ Radius: 3 Blocks        
        ▶ Charges: 2        
        ▶ Cooldown: 12s (refreshes all charges at once)        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Increase Steel Trap's radius.        
                 
        Steel Trap now applies vulnerability.        
                 
        ▶ Radius: 3 → 4 Blocks        
        ▶ Effect: 15% Vulnerability for 5s        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Steel Trap no longer detonates automatically.        
        Recasting when 2 Traps are primed detonates        
        them while also launching you.        
                 
        Increase Steel Trap's vulnerability and        
        decrease priming duration.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: 0% → 10% Vulnerability        
        ▶ Priming Duration: 1.5s → 0.5s        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
skill.extraDescription:
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        ʀᴇɢɪᴏɴ ѕᴄᴀʟᴇᴅ        
        Damage values will change depending        
        on the region you're currently in.        
                 
        ѕᴛᴀɢɢᴇʀ        
        Staggered mobs cannot attack and        
        their spells will be delayed.        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

skill.simpleDescription: Dash forward and stagger nearby mobs.
descriptions:
Trigger: Press key.swapOffhand        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Dash forward and stagger nearby mobs.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: Stagger for 1.5s        
        ▶ Radius: 3 Blocks

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

skill.name: Vicious Combos
skill.simpleDescription: Killing mobs reduces cooldowns, and killing Elite mobs completely refreshes them.
descriptions:
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Killing a mob reduces your ability cooldowns.        
                 
        Killing an Elite or Boss fully resets your        
        ability cooldowns instead.        
                 
        ▶ Normal Cooldown Reduction: 1s        
        ▶ Elite/Boss Cooldown Reduction: 100%        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Increase Vicious Combos's cooldown        
        reduction for killing normal mobs.        
                 
        ▶ Normal Cooldown Reduction: 1s → 1.5s        
                 
        Killing an Elite or Boss afflicts nearby        
        mobs with weakness and vulnerability.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: 15% Weakness for 5s        
        ▶ Effect: 15% Vulnerability for 5s        
        ▶ Radius: 5 Blocks        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        When an ability goes on cooldown, your next        
        attack within 3s will deal increased damage        
        and reduce the cooldown of that ability.        
                 
        ▶ Damage Boost: +20% (🗡)        
        ▶ Cooldown Reduction: 1s        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

skill.simpleDescription: Increase total damage dealt with axes and swords and gain resistance while holding a sword.
descriptions:
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        While holding a sword, gain resistance.        
                 
        ▶ Sword Effect: +10% Resistance        
                 
        While holding an axe, your attacks deal        
        increased damage.        
                 
        ▶ Axe Damage Boost: +2 + 5% (🗡)        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        While holding a sword, your attacks now        
        deal increased damage as well.        
                 
        ▶ Sword Damage Boost: +1 + 10% (🗡)        
                 
        While holding an axe, your attacks deal        
        even more damage.        
                 
        ▶ Axe Damage Boost: +2 + 5% → +4 + 10% (🗡)        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆

◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
        Increase Weapon Mastery's damage boost        
        for both weapons by an additional 10%.        
                 
        ▶ Sword Damage Boost: 0 + 0% → +0 + 10% (🗡)        
        ▶ Axe Damage Boost: 2 + 5% → +2 + 15% (🗡)        
                 
        While holding a sword, your attacks weaken mobs.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: 10% Weakness for 4s        
                 
        While holding an axe, gain speed.        
                 
        ▶ Effect: +15% Speed        
◆·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·–·◆
